title: Anticipating the hard question and the objection

videos.script: Every presentation has a moment when somebody leans back and asks the question you did not prepare for. {{lean}} Is that not just because the interior is further away? {{question}} If you have no answer, the room remembers the question and forgets the finding. If you have one, on a slide, in ten seconds, the finding gets stronger than it was before anybody asked. {{answer}} Most hard questions are not surprises. They come from five places, and you can list them the night before. {{five}} This lesson lists Faro's, answers the most dangerous one with the data, and practises answering in the room. Including the question that is really an attack. {{attack}}
